follow-up time: From delivery until discharge from hospital
cohort: All primigravidae delivering between 1976 and 2010 at Aberdeen Maternity Hospital
finding: Pregnancies complicated by antepartum bleeding of unknown origin were at a greater risk of preterm delivery and induced labor, but there was no increase in perinatal mortality after adjusting for preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with antepartum bleeding of unknown origin were more likely to have induced labor.
